method: Stripe live GET /v1/checkout/sessions?status=complete&limit=100, cursor pagination until has_more=false
scope: Success URL hostname exactly mcp.zovo.one; metadata.probe=1 excluded from commercial totals
limitations: All available completed Checkout Sessions at the snapshot, not all Stripe payment channels or business revenue.
Paid checkout gross amount precedes refunds, fees, disputes and taxes; no net revenue or profit claim.
Complete sessions can still be unpaid; payment_status=paid is separately required.
Untagged activity is not independently verified as human.
privacy: Only aggregates persisted. No raw session IDs, customer identities, payment intents, checkout URLs or credentials exported.
